$comment: Expected GitHub branch protection for `main`. Compared against the live API by
R-02 (required approving review) was applied by hand through the API and nothing
detected it being turned off again -- a setting that gates every merge was itself
unprotected. Changing protection is legitimate; changing it SILENTLY is not, so this
file must be updated in the same PR as any deliberate console change.
Contains no secrets: branch protection settings are public repository metadata.
